nodes.title: Main Design Document
nodes.description: Single source of truth for the BOUND BELOW run structure, controls, content, visual direction and production asset list.

nodes.title: Pitch
nodes.description: One-paragraph pitch and visual keywords used to keep generated art on direction.

data.text: BOUND BELOW — a small hooded child follows a red thread under the floorboards into a hand-inked basement of damp stone, stitched burlap and candle wax. Tight top-down twin-stick roguelike: clear rooms, choose items, break rocks, find the door down. Visual keywords: iron-gall ink outlines, old paper grain, soot black, bone cream, dried blood, one red thread, candle gold. No clean vector gloss, no neon, no generic fantasy gloss.
data.instruction: Use as style prompt source for mockups and key art.

nodes.title: Reference mockup — gameplay visual direction
nodes.description: Visual-direction mockup for the in-room gameplay frame: hand-inked top-down basement, hooded child, moths and stitched husks, hearts/coin HUD at the edges. Used as the style reference for production key art; not shipped as an in-game asset.

data.prompt: Original hand-inked storybook-horror game concept art, top-down view of a small stone basement room, no perspective camera tilt. A tiny hooded child in a ragged burlap cloak stands in the center with a faint red thread around one wrist, holding black inky tears that float upward. Around the room: two pale moths with dusty wings, a crawling stitched husk doll with button eyes, a cracked stone pillar, scattered bones, an iron-banded wooden door in the top wall, a small puddle reflecting candlelight. Dark soot-black ink outlines, rough iron-gall line work, old paper grain texture, muted palette of bone cream, parchment tan, damp olive stone, dried blood red and one thread-red accent. Candle-lit vignette, dusty air, subtle film grain. Minimal diegetic HUD icons only at the corners: three small stitched hearts top-left, a tiny gold coin and bone key, a scrap of parchment minimap top-right; no readable text anywhere. Wide 16:9 composition with the room centered and generous dark surround. Painterly yet graphic, tactile like an old print, cohesive, atmospheric, playful-creepy.

nodes.title: Production art — title key illustration
nodes.description: Shipped title/menu backdrop. Child at the top of the cellar stairs, red thread running down into the dark; negative space at left and bottom for the DOM title typography and menu.

data.prompt: Original hand-inked storybook-horror key illustration for a game title screen, 16:9. A tiny hooded child in a ragged burlap cloak, seen from behind three-quarter, stands at the top of worn wooden cellar stairs holding a small lantern, looking down into a vast ink-black basement. One thin red thread unspools from the child's wrist and trails down the stairs into the darkness, where two pale moth wings and one pair of button eyes catch the light far below. Damp stone walls, hanging cobwebs, candle stubs, scattered bones, a cracked door frame. Iron-gall ink line work with rough scratchy outlines, old paper grain, soot black, bone cream, parchment tan, damp olive and candle gold, single thread-red accent. Warm candle pool around the child against deep dark. Composition: child small in the right third, stairs leading diagonally down to the right, large calm dark negative space in the left half and lower corner for a title wordmark and menu buttons. No text, no letters, no logo, no UI. Painterly yet graphic, tactile old print, cohesive with the reference moodboard, atmospheric, mysterious, handcrafted.
